definitions.cohort: All baseline histogram excludedLevels whose reasons include branch-spawn; one entry per normalized levelId.
definitions.references: Literal branch parameters locate candidate callers; they do not prove execution, optionality, or call count. Base and selected enemy database rows remain candidates when overrides exist.
definitions.absence: No literal reference does not mean unused. Prefab/default bindings, environment code, and dynamic construction may call the branch.
definitions.buffCandidates: Owner/template name affinity is a research lead only, not a proved runtime binding. Catalog nodes can select routes without executing a SPAWN action.
definitions.proof: Only certificates already present in the current archive mark an action optional-omitted, non-enemy, or mandatory-counted. This audit never changes aggregation.
definitions.groupCounts: Reference, caller, environment, and family groups may overlap. Count maps by levelId, not display code.
definitions.unresolvedReasons: Group unresolvedReasons count maps with each hold reason; another mechanism on the same map may be responsible. Signals retain the source and strength of the inference.
